note: North Korea's won: the United Nations' operational rate of exchange, the rate the UN Treasury publishes for its own transactions in the country, 110 won to the US dollar in every entry from 15 January 2026 to the one for 1 November 2026, so one rate from 15 January 2026. The Central Bank of the DPRK publishes none this client could reach (its host doesn't resolve); market rates reported in the press (about 70,000 won to the dollar in 2026) aren't taken. Read from the UN Treasury's CSV export on 2026-10-30, and again on 2026-11-03 from its rate history for the won (the export gave nothing that day without its form): 110 in every entry from 15 January 2026 to the one for 1 November 2026.
